hook: Your courtiers bow out of their attacks so one crowned favourite strikes again and again, out of turn.
loop: In the fight, units Gust: extra attacks out of turn order.
Every Gust adds to the Gale, the dial the next shop reads.
The Gale pays back as gold, permanent stats and Gale Warnings.

growth.line: Small permanent steps each turn off the Gale, plus big in-fight Attack spikes from Gust chains late.

feel.early: Thin: Gust Page and small bodies.
feel.mid: Vane and Bora: your front row swings first.
feel.late: A crowned favourite takes the whole court's Gusts.

stars.why: Everyone else Defers: the board becomes one favourite's queue.
Takes the return hits for whoever Gusts; the soaker the plan needs.
Whole front row Gusts before the enemy moves; the T4 spike.

card_short.u02: Grows itself permanently each turn the Gale is up.
card_short.u03: Defer; the unit that Gusts instead gets extra Attack.
card_short.u04: Twice a fight, an ally that Gusts grows permanently.
card_short.u05: Gold each turn if the Gale is 3 or more.
card_short.u06: After a kill, gains Attack and Gusts.
card_short.u07: Your side attacks first; your leftmost front unit Gusts.
card_short.u08: Grows your biggest unit permanently by Gale size.
card_short.u09: Defer; gives your biggest other unit Shield.
card_short.u10: Start of Combat: your whole front row Gusts.
card_short.u11: Once a cycle, the unit on its left Gusts again.
card_short.u12: Grows your whole board permanently at Gale 5, more at 10.
card_short.u13: At Gale 8 or more, get a Gale Warning.
card_short.u14: Any of your units that kills Gusts, once a cycle.
card_short.u15: Defer; takes the damage your Gusting allies would take.
card_short.u16: Swoop; Gusts after each normal attack, first one free.
card_short.u17: Everyone but your biggest unit Defers; biggest grows per Gust.
card_short.u18: Cleave; Defers until Gale 6, then Gusts and grows per Gust.
card_short.u19: Gusts count double toward the Gale; at 20, everyone Gusts.
card_short.x01: Item: give any unit a permanent Start of Combat Gust.

builds.name: The Favourite
builds.line: Defer courtiers feed one biggest unit, any tribe; Föhn soaks.

builds.name: Squall Line
builds.line: Vane, Bora, Windhover, Lord Mistral: the front row swings first.

builds.name: Barometer
builds.line: Gale as a resource: Wild Hunt doubles it for every reader.

liked: Lady High Pressure: a real capstone that makes 'who is biggest' the decision.
Defer and a Gale the shop reads back feel fresh; seating is a puzzle.
worries: Lady High Pressure: when 'biggest' is checked mid-fight isn't stated (one reviewer wants it fixed).
Watch: Föhn, Lady and Couriers may make an unkillable favourite; Wild Hunt spikes too.
changed: Lady High Pressure no longer makes the favourite Defer, so the Favourite build works.
Sir Vane gets a tiebreak when both sides have him.
Föhn soaks Bristle too; Thunderhead and Wild Hunt now fire at 'or more'.
verdict: Fun 7, distinct 7, two of three said settle; ranked third of three. For players who love seating puzzles and one huge carry.
